method: Four searches by hand (web search only, each finding cross-checked: the company's own page, or two independent dated sources), for the week of Oct 13-20, 2026: online stores' sales, single-product online deals, Austin weekly ads and restaurant promotions, and regular deals in Austin, Houston and Dallas. Slomp's sources could not be read from the session that ran it (its network allowed none of them), so Slomp's side is the published site's build logs and the earlier live runs in this folder; the posts the manual search found on Slomp's own sources were run through Slomp's own feed parsers and filters offline, before and after this change ('replay'). The search tool's quota (200 searches per turn) ended each search short of its target.

regulars.coverage_note: Partial sweep. The shared WebSearch budget (200 calls per turn, all agents) ran out after about 30 searches by this agent. Movie theaters were swept fully. Kids-eat-free was sampled. Not swept: most restaurant chains' weekly deals, retail days, museums, zoos, bowling and boba/coffee. WebFetch could not reach company sites (ENOTFOUND), so every finding below comes from search-result snippets of the named pages.

Its Houston-area branch is Santikos Grand-Conroe 14 (Conroe), which Cinema Treasures lists; the chain itself does not confirm that branch. Its other Texas branches are in San Antonio.
